definition: without a clearly defined shape or form
memoryTip: A-morph (no shape) — like a blob with no outline.
correctPassage: The coalition’s goals stayed amorphous until members agreed on a written platform.
wrongPassages: The engineer preferred amorphous blueprints with every joint and load path labeled.
Her amorphous schedule listed exact times for each meeting through the month.
The sculpture was amorphous only after the chisel had fixed every sharp edge in place.

memoryTip: Spurious ~ suspicious — a fake claim dressed up as real.
correctPassage: Peer review exposed the spurious citation, which pointed to a paper that never existed.
wrongPassages: Auditors called the ledger spurious once every entry matched the bank records exactly.
She trusted the spurious passport because the biometrics confirmed her identity.
The museum displayed a spurious original whose provenance had been verified for centuries.

memoryTip: Co-roborate: two sources back each other up and kill the doubt.
correctPassage: Satellite images corroborate the villagers’ reports of flooding along the lower valley.
wrongPassages: The blank page was said to corroborate the model without a single measurement attached.
She corroborated the rumor by declining every interview and deleting her notes.
A second lab moved to corroborate the claim by discarding the original data set.

definition: asserting opinions as if they were absolute truths
memoryTip: Like a dog that won’t drop the bone — stubborn about “my truth.”
correctPassage: His dogmatic certainty that the model needed no revision left no room for contrary data.
wrongPassages: A dogmatic researcher welcomes every challenge and revises claims at the first doubt.
The minutes were dogmatic only in listing motions, votes, and abstentions in order.
She took a dogmatic approach by listing three competing hypotheses and testing each.

memoryTip: No scruples (moral brakes) — will cut any corner for gain.
correctPassage: Unscrupulous brokers steered clients into products that maximized fees rather than returns.
wrongPassages: Reviewers called the methods unscrupulous once every step could be repeated independently.
His unscrupulous honesty led him to return the overpayment and report the error.
The clinic’s unscrupulous standards required full consent and transparent billing for all patients.
